source: claude-code subagent (viewed all 4 contact sheets + profile + transcript)
summary: A 26:12 'pov' episode: a day trip from Hong Kong into Shenzhen for a tech conference, then a fan run in Bali/Indonesia, and a sober closing reflection. It opens with a palm-payment moment at a convenience store (repeated later in context) after a brief office lead-in. The middle crosses the border, rides in a chauffeured car with translated Chinese dialogue, shows him on a conference stage screen, and announces a 6 a.m. meetup run via an Instagram story. A desk explainer with a screen recording leads to the dawn run with a crowd. The final four minutes are a bookshelf sit-down admitting low energy and struggles.
hook_analysis: Lead-in then a novelty: office wides (0:00-0:10) then paying by palm at a 7-Eleven (0:20-0:49) with surprised reactions and 'Chinese:' subtitles; the same scene is replayed in place at 11:02-11:22, so the opening is a flash-forward teaser of a curious moment. Most-replayed segment is the first ~16 s.
narrative_arc: Office/new CFO (0:59-1:09) -> drive and border crossing (1:19-5:06) -> back-seat ride with a driver (5:26-7:45) -> passport insert (8:14-8:34) -> SHENZHEN card (8:54) -> conference (9:04-10:53) -> palm pay in context (11:02) -> night hotel/car (11:42-12:51) -> story announcing run (13:11) -> desk explainer with screen recording (13:41-18:08) -> '29TH OF JULY' dawn run (18:17-21:15) -> plane/contract inserts (21:25-21:55) -> bookshelf reflection and sign-off (22:05-26:02).
camera_and_composition: Driver-side profile shots in a car (1:19-3:28); rear-seat wide with sunroof (5:26-7:45); hand inserts of passport stamps; stage shot with his name on screen (10:03-10:23); static desk medium with picture-in-picture screen recording (16:19-17:18); wide locked-off street shot of the crowd at dawn (18:27-20:06); final static medium ending with him reaching to the camera (26:02). Rounded-corner inserts at 0:00, 21:25, 21:45. Cut detail not observable at storyboard resolution.
color_and_grade: Mostly neutral to cool and darker (brightness 0.29, 21% low-key) - car interiors, conference halls, night hotels - with a sodium-orange dawn street at the meetup and a pink-lit bookshelf at the end.
sound_and_music: ~82% speech at ~128 wpm; speech-free music passages at the open (0:08-0:34), entering the conference (8:59-9:52) and at the run (~21:30). Translated 'Chinese:' captions for dialogue.
what_to_borrow: Open on a novel local moment and replay it in context later
Passport/border inserts to mark a crossing
Bold yellow date card ('29TH OF JULY') over a dark establishing shot
Wide locked-off shot of a gathered crowd while you speak to them
End on an honest low-energy reflection rather than a hype outro
what_to_avoid_copying: Screen-recording explainers inside a travel story
Long talk from the back seat of a car (2+ min) with one angle
Pivoting countries mid-film without a clear bridge
